edusharing-desc: Enables the inclusion of media content from the Edu-Sharing Repository
edusharing-missing-keys-hint: No edu-sharing keys found. Run the maintenance script "php extensions/EduSharing/maintenance/createKeys.php" and register this installation at the repository.
edusharing-signature-invalid-hint: Signature verification failed. Did you register the EduSharing extension at repository using the current keys?
edusharing-popup-blocked: Your browser blocked the edu-sharing window. Allow pop-ups for this wiki and try again.
edusharing-ticket-failed: Could not obtain an edu-sharing session. Check that this wiki is registered at the repository.
apierror-edusharing-unavailable: The edu-sharing repository is not available: $1
apierror-edusharing-noticket: Could not obtain a ticket from the edu-sharing repository. This wiki may not be registered at the repository, or the configured repository user does not exist.
apihelp-edusharingticket-example-1: Get a repository picker URL for the current user
